verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC&VC page explicitly states it serves both 'high-growth companies' and 'venture capital and growth equity investors,' covering term sheets, investor rights and governance from both perspectives, and the venture financing page similarly serves both 'lenders and borrowers.' Missing for 10: explicit investor-side case studies (most examples shown are company-side like N26/Flock) and independent corroboration of dual-side market-term expertise.
